megatron-tokenization-format:
<svg viewBox="0 0 600 224" role="img" aria-labelledby="megatron-tokenization-format-title megatron-tokenization-format-desc">
        <title id="megatron-tokenization-format-title">Megatron's indexed token files</title>
        <desc id="megatron-tokenization-format-desc">Two documents share one binary token file. Document zero has three int32 tokens and starts at byte zero; document one has four tokens and starts at byte twelve. The index records those lengths and byte offsets. Each document ends with token 128001.</desc>
        <defs><marker id="megatron-tokenization-format-arrow" viewBox="0 0 10 10" refX="8" refY="5" markerWidth="5" markerHeight="5" orient="auto-start-reverse"><path class="arrowhead" d="M 0 0 L 10 5 L 0 10 Z"></path></marker></defs>
        <text class="label" x="8" y="72">.bin</text>
        <text class="document" x="212" y="28">Document 0</text>
        <text class="document" x="450" y="28">Document 1</text>
        <rect class="a" x="112" y="48" width="64" height="40" rx="3"></rect>
              <text class="token" x="144" y="73">17</text><rect class="a" x="180" y="48" width="64" height="40" rx="3"></rect>
              <text class="token" x="212" y="73">42</text><rect class="a" x="248" y="48" width="64" height="40" rx="3"></rect>
              <text class="token" x="280" y="73">128001</text><rect class="b" x="316" y="48" width="64" height="40" rx="3"></rect>
              <text class="token" x="348" y="73">9</text><rect class="b" x="384" y="48" width="64" height="40" rx="3"></rect>
              <text class="token" x="416" y="73">81</text><rect class="b" x="452" y="48" width="64" height="40" rx="3"></rect>
              <text class="token" x="484" y="73">6</text><rect class="b" x="520" y="48" width="64" height="40" rx="3"></rect>
              <text class="token" x="552" y="73">128001</text>
        <path class="link" d="M 144 152 L 144 94" marker-end="url(#megatron-tokenization-format-arrow)"></path>
        <path class="link" d="M 348 152 L 348 94" marker-end="url(#megatron-tokenization-format-arrow)"></path>
        <text class="label" x="8" y="181">.idx</text>
        <rect class="index" x="112" y="156" width="200" height="60" rx="3"></rect>
        <rect class="index" x="320" y="156" width="268" height="60" rx="3"></rect>
        <text x="212" y="180">Offset: 0 bytes</text>
        <text x="212" y="200">Length: 3 tokens</text>
